*Please note I don't usually teach children, however I sometimes make exceptions*

course_info.trial_description:
This is a trial lesson, we will discuss any specific goals you have with English. During the trail lesson I will assess your level, your immediate needs, and areas that you may want to improve in the future. You can also tell me what you are looking for and what your goals and motivations are.  We can also determine what topics you are most interested in, so I can best plan your future lessons. 

Assessing your level in the trial lesson is important, as it allows me to be able to better prepare customised lesson plans for you and to therefore be a better teacher for you in your future lessons with me. 

In addition, you can learn about my teaching style, the courses I offer and which of my lessons would best suit you. You can also use this time to determine whether I would be the most suitable teacher for your needs. 

** Please note as this is a trial lesson if all questions and answers are answered within 30 minutes then the trial may end before the stated end time**

pro_course_detail.title: Natural Conversation Speaking Practice  - No Materials & No Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
During these sessions you will be able to practice your speaking and conversational skills; and work towards achieving fluency through unplanned, spontaneous casual conversations. We can talk about any suitable topics. 

The ultimate goal of conversation practice is to improve your fluency and confidence. A secondary goal of informal conversation practice is to learn new words, vocabulary items and phrases, as well as to practice unrehearsed listening and speaking skills. This is a useful skill to have at any level. 

Depending upon your comfort and preference I can offer immediate and/or delayed correction.

I have lots of interests and I am happy to talk about anything but I particularly enjoy talking about the following topics and hobbies: philosophy, travel, cooking and food, poetry, learning languages, politics, books, fashion, psychology, animals, different cultures, sport and fitness.

I take notes during classes about any new words, phrases, or corrections that you may wish to later review. 

Please note: Lessons may end 5 minutes early to ensure adequate preparation time for following lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Perfect Your English! General English Lessons for Levels A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2 (Grammar, Vocabulary, Pronunciation, Listening, Reading, Communication Lessons)
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's focus on some specific aspects of English together with these general English classes for beginners, intermediate, and advanced learners! 

In these lessons we will go through whatever it is exactly that you think you need to work on and also what I, as your teacher, have evaluated you need to work on when we discussed your English language level and ability in our first lesson. 

I can provide customised lessons for all levels, from A1 up to C2. Lesson plans will be made in advance by me so that the class is efficient and covers your learning objectives. Homework will be given if you are a regular student.

Classes can focus on improving various aspects of your English. Grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, speaking, writing, listening, and reading can all be covered over our lessons, with each lesson focusing on different skills .

Any queries, questions, or confusion you may have regarding the correct ways of using: certain grammar rules, pronouncing words or sounds, vocabulary, phrases, idioms, etc can be covered. These lessons will focus on whatever improvements you need to better your English. 

Feedback will be provided at the end of the lesson. Homework will also be given to regular students who want it. 

*Please note I speak with an Australian accent and I will not be able to effectively teach you Standard American Pronunciation. If you want help sounding Australian, I can however do that.*

Please note: Lessons may end 5 minutes early to ensure adequate preparation time for following lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve your Written English! English Writing Classes for Levels A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2
pro_course_detail.description:
The aim of these writing classes is to enhance your English proficiency by providing the space, time, skills, and techniques tailored to your level. Whether you're just starting with A1 or already advanced at C2, this class will help you improve your writing skills and gain confidence as an effective writer.

We’ll cover a range of topics and writing styles, including academic essays, creative writing, business writing, and more. Our focus will be on grammar, syntax, vocabulary, punctuation, and organising thoughts to craft compelling arguments. For beginners, we can start from the basics—even the English alphabet—with handwritten practice if needed.

You’ll have the chance to practise through various activities and homework assignments, such as short essays, journal entries, and other writing tasks. I will provide constructive feedback to help you refine your work and develop your own unique style.

With consistent practice, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to handle any writing task, from formal emails to university-level essays. If you wish to focus on proofreading, correction, or strengthening academic writing skills, I can guide you through areas of improvement in pieces you’ve written.

My goal is to help you become a fluent and confident writer, expressing yourself effectively in English. With practice you can achieve your goals, book a lesson with me to start!

pro_course_detail.title: Enhance Your Spoken English! Structured English Conversation Classes Suitable for A2, B1, B2, C1, C2 Students
pro_course_detail.description:
Let’s focus on improving your English speaking skills through structured conversation! 

**These lessons will enhance your overall accuracy in speaking, pronunciation, vocabulary, general fluency, and boost your confidence when speaking.**

If you want structured conversations or lack the confidence to speak freely in an unprepared way, these classes can help. They will develop your confidence, accuracy, and fluency in English. In these lessons, we’ll focus on areas you feel you need to work on, as well as those I identify through my evaluation of your level and ability in our first lesson and then in ongoing lessons.

We’ll work on speaking and listening skills, pronunciation (through drilling if you want/need), and how to speak in both planned and impromptu situations. Depending on your preference, I can offer either immediate or delayed correction. I will naturally introduce more challenging vocabulary and conversations as you progress, and I encourage active and engaged participation.

I offer lessons for all levels from A1 to C2. Lesson plans will be tailored in advance to make our classes efficient and aligned with your learning objectives. Homework will be provided if you’re a regular student.

At the end of each class, I’ll give you brief feedback, and after the lesson, I’ll send a detailed summary, including corrections, learning materials, vocabulary to practise, pronunciation tips, and any homework.

*Please note I speak with an Australian accent and cannot teach Standard American Pronunciation or Received Pronunciation. However, I can help you sound more Australian if that’s your goal.*

Please note: Lessons may end 5 minutes early to ensure adequate preparation time for following lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: G'day! Learn Australian English. For B2-C2 Students
pro_course_detail.description:
You’ve been learning English for some time, and you can speak it reasonably well. However, when you interact with Australians or visit Australia you might find yourself struggling to understand the locals.

If that sounds like you, then this course is exactly what you need!

I'm a native Australian English speaker and teacher, and I’ve designed these classes to help you understand the vocabulary and pronunciation used by everyday Australians. I’ll also help you sound more like a native speaker from Straya!

My Australian English lessons cover everything from a basic introduction to Australian English, to its grammatical, lexical, vocabulary, and phonetic differences compared with Standard British or American English. I also offer classes on phonetics, vocabulary, colloquial expressions, idioms, and slang.

In each class, I’ll introduce and explain the key focus, and then we’ll practise using new vocabulary and expressions in conversation. The more classes you take, the more you’ll build your knowledge of Australian English.

At the end of each class, you'll receive a summary of the key information taught, the learning materials of that lesson, along with feedback on your performance and tips for improvement.

If you want to sound like a native Australian English speaker, or simply understand them better, I invite you to join these lessons.

Please note: Lessons may end 5 minutes early to ensure adequate preparation time for following lessons.
